summary.en: One thread gathers every star: the spine retracts into the mascot, the thread's head sweeps the sky in three passes along one smooth path catching each star it passes, the line straightens into a tether, and the caught stars flow along it into its end, which glows as one point.
summary.zh: 一根线收回所有星：主干缩回吉祥物，线头沿一条平滑路径在夜空里扫三趟，经过的星被接到线上，线拉直成一根系绳，接住的星顺着它流进末端，末端亮成一个点。

fits: The climax of a film that sent many things out: everything comes back to one place.
notFor: Fewer than about eight stars; a film that has not sent stars out before.

intent.en: Everything that was sent out comes back to one point the user can look at.
intent.zh: 派出去的一切都回到一个用户看得过来的点。

content.en: Nothing to read: the stars in the sky (count, seed) and the point they flow into.
content.zh: 没有字：夜空里的星（数量、种子）和它们流进去的那个点。

fits.zh: 派出很多东西的片子的高潮：一切回到一处。

notFor.zh: 少于八颗左右的星；之前没派出过星的片子。

en: Catch each star on the frame the head passes it; a star that jumps early breaks the one-thread logic.
The path must not cross itself near a star or the catch reads twice.
zh: 线头经过哪颗星就在那一帧接住它；提前跳上线的星会打破“一根线”的逻辑。
路径不能在星附近自交，否则接住会看起来发生了两次。
